purpose.zh: 打开肩部，拉伸背阔肌和胸部
purpose.en: Open the shoulders and stretch the lats and chest.

text.zh: 手臂伸直，胸口向大腿方向压
text.en: Keep your arms straight and press your chest toward your thighs

text.zh: 臀部推高，背部拉长，脚跟向地面
text.en: Push your hips high, keep your back long, and reach your heels down.

text.zh: 保持呼吸，再回到普通下犬式
text.en: Breathe, then ease back to a neutral downward dog.

cautions.zh: 只拉到舒适的程度，出现疼痛就放松
cautions.en: Stretch only to a comfortable point, and ease off if anything hurts.

cautions.zh: 先做手腕热身；手腕刺痛或发麻就停止
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists first, and stop if they feel sharp pain or numbness.
